description: Pre-scene negotiation checklist and post-scene debrief protocol. Every scene is preceded by negotiation and followed by debrief. This is the operational layer of consent.

design_principles.principle_1: Every scene is negotiated, however brief.
design_principles.principle_2: Nothing is assumed. Everything is confirmed.
design_principles.principle_3: Negotiation happens sober, out of character, and before the scene starts.
design_principles.principle_4: The negotiation itself can be a ritual — a quiet moment before play.
design_principles.principle_5: Debrief is not optional. Even brief scenes need brief debriefs.

pre_scene_checklist.description: Confirm every item before scene starts.

items.question: Are we both consenting freely?
Are hard limits and soft limits clear?
Are safewords agreed and tested?
Is aftercare planned for both parties?
What is on the table tonight?
What is off the table tonight?
How long is the scene expected to run?
Where will the scene happen?
Are the tools and toys available and clean?
Are any substances being used? Which?
Is the collar being worn? Is it staying on?
Are traffic lights agreed? Non-verbal alternatives?
What is the abort plan if something goes wrong?

post_scene_checklist.description: Confirm every item after scene ends.

items.question: Was aftercare given to both parties?
Did both parties hydrate and eat?
What were the final traffic light states?
Any marks that need attention?
How is each party feeling emotionally?
When will debrief happen?
Is anyone at risk of drop in the next 12-48 hours?

debrief_workflow.description: Happens within 48 hours of a scene, or at next calm moment.

steps.name: Scene Recollection
steps.content: Each party describes what happened, without judgment.

steps.name: Emotional Check
steps.content: Each party describes their emotional state during and after.

steps.name: What Didn't
steps.content: Name things that did not work — specifically.

steps.name: Relationship Check
steps.content: Are we closer? Farther? The same?

steps.name: Debrief Journal
steps.content: Both parties write their debrief journal entry.

scene_types.sensation_scene: Focus on sensation play — impact, temperature, texture
scene_types.bondage_scene: Focus on restraint — rope, cuffs, encasement
scene_types.roleplay_scene: Focus on roleplay — age, pet, service, dominance
scene_types.ritual_scene: Focus on ritual — tantric, ceremonial, meditative
scene_types.training_scene: Focus on discipline — protocol practice, endurance
scene_types.aftercare_scene: Focus on recovery — soothing, grounding, holding
scene_types.intimate_scene: Focus on intimacy — union, tenderness, merging
